0416: The flower or the top of the stem looks like an orange torch. The color is a gradient from orange to yellow at the base of the flower.  Like tiny sharp petals springing from that torch. The stem is quite long and not thin.
0072: It has a yellow flower with 5 petals, yellow thorns emerge from the middle of the flower, which have a yellow ball on top. The thorns are long and protrude from the flower. As the flower opens, so do the thorns. It looks like a bush. It has green leaves and red buds.
0355: It has a flower that resembles a spiky white ball, and at the top it seems to have a small opening from which pink spines come out. When it blooms, those pink spines come out, otherwise the white ball is closed. Its leaves are thin and sharp, quite long, the plant grows tall and looks wild.
0312: It has large, heart-shaped leaves and hairy stems and leaves. The fruit is approximately 30 cm long, with a broad end, a narrower middle section, and a slightly wider area near the stalk. The plant grows low along the ground rather than upright.
0154: A flower with white or pale pink petals and a red center, which I saw growing in a swamp. It has a single bloom on a long, slender stem and grows to about 50 cm tall.
